findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: amt_iso_optimize · Public sink: amt_iso_optimize · Destructive: concentration_analyze, protective_put_price.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: amt_iso_optimize · Public sink: amt_iso_optimize · Destructive: concentration_analyze, protective_put_price

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
